what: A hand drawing flattens horizontally to .02 (.3s power2.in), then unfolds into a different pose (or the same drawing flipped if there is none) (.3s power2.out), holds for .5s, and returns the same way — a ”paper doll flip”: one cycle, a 3s rest, then repeat. Starts when it enters the screen and stops when it leaves

options.[data-fx-part=back]: (if present) the picture in the changed pose — layered in the same spot as the previous picture. If absent, the part duplicates the previous picture and layers a left-right flipped copy (swapped in as transparent so the scale stays positive)
options.hold: Seconds to hold the changed pose, default .5
options.rest: Seconds of rest after one spin, default 3

from.where: shared.js data-flip hand drawing (original micro flip-whole — scaleX .02 · .3s power2.in/out · .5s hold · 3s rest)
